name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 26 - Am 115
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 26 a. Stresses that the Union’s outermost regions, including the overseas countries and territories (OCTs) require specific support due to their remoteness; draws particular attention to the difficulties in access to drinking water and sanitation, to the functioning of water infrastructure, and to the need to create appropriate new infrastructure; notes in particular the poor condition of water distribution networks, which constitute common problems for the outermost regions; observes with concern that, while these problems are among the priorities of the Union’s external humanitarian action, the Union’s outermost regions do not appear to receive the support they deserve in addressing these serious issues;
